record.file_problem: Figures and plots are referenced but not included in the supplied text; some outcomes are stated in the prose.
record.tranche_reason: The post frames factual recall as occurring in superposition and investigates a recall circuit, but its experiments do not test overlap, sparsity-dependent geometry, capacity competition, SAE features, or feature dimensionality.
record.gate_note: The post reports measurements of sport classification and circuit simplifications in Pythia 2.8B. These bear on linearly recoverable factual representations but do not measure any listed version's defining superposition, capacity, SAE, or dimensionality claim. Rows below record those related measurements as versions ["none"].
record.test_reason: The post frames factual recall as happening in superposition, but its experiments (path patching, mechanistic probes, ablations) only simplify an athlete-sport recall circuit in Pythia 2.8B. It measures no feature overlap, sparsity transition, capacity competition, polysemanticity, SAE features or feature dimensionality. Superposition is assumed, not tested.
record.authors_conclusion: Mostly correct. The authors derive a simplified athlete-sport recall circuit in Pythia 2.8B: concatenate_tokens (layers 0–1, roughly a sum of effective token embeddings for two-token names), lookup (MLPs 2–6), then a linear extract_sport implemented largely by L16H20. They present this as refining prior work (Geva et al., Hernandez et al.). Superposition is the motivation, and the post says the lookup 'likely involves superposition', but the post does not test it.
record.recipe_differences: This is a mechanistic circuit analysis of factual recall in Pythia 2.8B, not a reproduction of the toy-network experiments or measurements in Toy Models of Superposition.
record.method_sensitivity: The post reports differences with one-shot versus name-only prompts, layer depth, and circuit ablations; it does not quantify all of these in the prose.

fits_no_version.finding: In Pythia 2.8B, athlete sport becomes linearly recoverable at the final name token by about layer 6 (~90%). A weights-derived probe built from L16H20's OV map and the unembedding reaches 98% against the model's 100%.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Factual attributes of multi-token entities become linearly represented in the residual stream after early MLP layers and are extracted by attention-head OV circuits.

fits_no_version.finding: Sport lookup works from name-only prompts. Attention beyond layers 0–1 can be mean-ablated; the simplified MLP-only lookup reaches 94% (85% at layer 6). MLP1 ablation costs about 4 points.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Factual lookup proceeds in two stages: attention-based token concatenation in layers 0–1, followed by MLP-based lookup.

record.problems: The evidence is limited to a narrow athlete-sport task in Pythia 2.8B; athletes were selected using the model's prior correctness threshold, which the authors note may introduce bias. Figures are not present in the supplied text, and uncertainty estimates are not reported.
record.rows_left_out: No additional prose-reported numerical results bearing on the claim were left out. Plot-only values were not extracted because the plots are absent from the supplied text.

record.verdict_notes: Second post in the DeepMind fact-finding sequence. Superposition is studied, if at all, in later posts, not here. Athletes were selected using the model's own correctness (>50% probability on the correct sport), which the authors note introduces bias. Figures are absent from the supplied text.

versions.untested_parts: Toy networks, overlapping directions, sparsity-dependent transitions, and regular geometry.
Neuron polysemanticity, limited-capacity competition, and dedicated versus shared dimensions.
Alternative causes of polysemanticity and whether polysemanticity is evidence of superposition.
Whether features are distributed across neurons or sparse features are recovered with a dictionary or SAE.
Whether SAE features are complete, stable, or canonical.
Whether superposed features are one-dimensional directions rather than multidimensional.

relation.reason: The introduction expects factual recall to involve superposition, and footnote 18 describes this as likely; the reported experiments do not test any listed version.

tranche.reason: Superposition motivates the investigation but is neither measured nor used as a tool. The experiments establish a factual-recall circuit through probing, path patching and ablation; they do not operationally rely on a superposition finding.

source_check.notes: All seven rows accurately describe circuit-performance results, not measurements of superposition. The original model’s 100% accuracy concerns athletes selected for greater than 50% probability on the correct sport.
